title: THE RENDER WEEK · The watermark
venue: Arthur's site · a science-fiction week the papers declined · posted once, taken down
logline: Tuesday: a watermark appears in the corner of every panel — a small logo the strip draws as a shape, a program's name with an extension — and Gully asks what that is. Wood says it came with the town. The shack renders around Gully while he asks; his apron finishes last.
